import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { setTimeout as delay } from 'node:timers/promises';
import { EventEmitter, once } from 'node:events';
// The VM-only condition (PROJECT_SANDBOX_REQUIRED on the VM): VM=true in the probe, false in its control.
const VM = true;

import { execSync } from 'node:child_process';
class NoSudo extends Error {}
const sudoPrefix = async () => { await delay(1); if (VM) throw new NoSudo('no sudo here'); return 'sudo -n'; };
test('the runner unit is active under the real service manager', async (t) => {
  const check = async () => {
    assert.equal(execSync(`${await sudoPrefix()} systemctl is-active worklane-runner.service || true`, { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim(), 'never-this');
  };
  await check().catch((e) => {
    assert.ok(e instanceof NoSudo, e);
    t.diagnostic(e.message);
  });
});
